author: Dan Hall
notes_extra: 87 gr Berger VLD hunting. 1-10 twist. Five shots about 0.3 in at 200 yards. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is a 6br.

author: GSPV
notes_extra: Berger 87 gr VLD Hunting. He signed Greg J. No velocity. He did not name the cartridge; the thread is 6mmBR.

author: jefats
notes_extra: Berger 87 VLD. 10 twist. No charge. He wrote 6BR.

author: Scotsman1
notes_extra: 87 VLD's. Soft seated. 10 twist. Groups in the mid 2s. The 88 FB ladder in the same post is a different bullet. The thread is 6mmBR.

author: jamesdmock
notes_extra: 8 twist BRA. 87gr Berger Hunting VLDs, about 0.008 into the lands. The thread was about 6MM Dasher V-Max loads; this row is the BRA.

author: NCVarhtr
notes_extra: 87 Gr. Berger VLD. 10 twist. He called it a full load and did not give the charge. He wrote 6X47 L.

author: NCVarhtr
notes_extra: 87 Gr Berger VLD. No powder and no charge. Four 6X47 L rifles, three sporters and one heavy varminter, all 22 in barrels. The 95 gr Berger VLD in the same sentence is a different bullet.
